build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball that must hit the left or right wall
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable scale and position in the PHYRE scene
add_static_bar: add a static bar obstacle with configurable scale, angle, and position to block the ball
update_task_relationships: update the task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and target wall
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.PRE_TWO_BALLS to classify difficulty level
